terminalResult: A single local support-stratified dispatcher exists on fixed-rank patches, but the eliminated response has no canonical continuation through a rank change from the limiting block alone. Global composition must carry approach/residue data or remain split.

findings.statement: A constant-support, range-compatible real-coupling Schur operation preserves analyticity and Herglotz passivity and is covariant under support-frame changes with the metric/projector data transported.
The families D_t=t z with B_t=b sqrt(t) and B_t=b t approach the same limiting block but yield different eliminated limits; the limiting block therefore does not select a canonical continuation.
Ward support transports on a constant-rank patch under the range condition; a forbidden null coupling produces regulator divergence.
KMS transports only under one common temperature and the declared reciprocal real coupling assumptions.
A probe-visible wall pole transports as residue data, but the projected boundary response does not determine an invisible bulk chiral index.

strongestFalsifier: Exhibit two paths with identical full decorated approach data, not merely the same limiting block, that still yield inequivalent external responses. That would defeat the proposed repair by approach/residue decoration and force permanently separate calculi.
nextDiscriminant: Test whether a groupoid- or measure-valued object containing support transition, approach-scaling and positive residue data makes the rank-changing output path-independent. Refuse a global law if it does not.
